english: The plan folded in and soft-deleted.
translation: 将被并入并软删除的计划。

english: Optional; recorded in the merge history.

translation: 两个计划 ID 均为必填。

english: The surviving and duplicate plans must differ.
translation: 保留计划与重复计划必须不同。

english: Merge {dup} into {main}? The duplicate is soft-deleted.
translation: 确定将 {dup} 合并到 {main} 吗？重复计划将被软删除。

english: Could not copy — copy it from the address bar
translation: 无法复制 — 请从地址栏复制
来自 authentication-service（魔法链接登录）。
没有超过匹配阈值的项。

english: No open ideas — capture one above.
translation: 暂无开放想法 — 请在上方记录。

english: Map items to objectives from each item's governance panel.
translation: 请在各工作项的治理面板中将其关联到目标。

english: No allocations yet — add them on an item's governance panel.
translation: 暂无分配 — 请在工作项的治理面板中添加。

english: Schedules are drawn per portfolio umbrella.
translation: 进度表按伞形组合绘制。

english: A magic link sent to your email: no password to leak or reuse.
translation: 魔法链接发送到你的邮箱：没有密码可泄露或重复使用。

english: Fine-grained rules decide who may read, write, merge or delete.
translation: 细粒度规则决定谁可以读取、写入、合并或删除。

english: An append-only history records every change and who made it.
translation: 仅追加的历史记录会记下每一次更改及操作者。

english: Sensitive details are masked unless you are entitled to see them.
translation: 除非你有权查看，否则敏感信息会被屏蔽。

english: REST with OpenAPI, and HL7 FHIR where health systems need it.
translation: REST 搭配 OpenAPI，并在医疗系统需要时支持 HL7 FHIR。

english: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Hindi, Spanish and Welsh.
translation: 阿拉伯语、中文、德语、英语、法语、印地语、西班牙语和威尔士语。

english: Sign in with a magic link sent to your email. No password needed.
translation: 通过发送到邮箱的魔法链接登录，无需密码。
每项计划，一个互联视图

english: Manage portfolios, projects, and products in one recursive plan tree, from first idea to delivery, with governance, schedules, and an audit trail built in.
translation: 在一棵递归的计划树中管理组合、项目和产品，从最初的想法到交付，并内置治理、进度计划和审计记录。

english: Every plan can contain any other, from a whole portfolio down to a single task.
translation: 任何计划都可以包含其他计划，从整个组合到单个任务。

english: Dashboards roll up stage, risk, and budget status across every plan.
translation: 仪表板汇总所有计划的阶段、风险和预算状态。

english: Matching flags a likely duplicate plan as it is created, and merging keeps one.
translation: 创建时匹配会标出疑似重复的计划，合并后只保留一份。

english: Executive, finance, and technology views show what needs attention now.
translation: 管理层、财务和技术视图显示当前需要关注的事项。

english: Kanban boards and burndown charts show real progress, not wishful status.
translation: 看板和燃尽图展示真实进展，而非一厢情愿的状态。

english: Ideas become proposals, then plans, through a pipeline everyone can see.
translation: 想法经过人人可见的流程，变成提案，再变成计划。

english: An optional kind label and a parent link, with roll-ups through every level.
translation: 可选的类型标签和父级链接，并逐层汇总。

english: A Kanban board, sprints, and an honest burndown for each plan.
translation: 每项计划都有看板、冲刺和真实的燃尽图。

english: Stage gates, risks, budget lines, benefits, and milestones in one panel.
translation: 阶段关口、风险、预算项、效益和里程碑集于一个面板。

english: Dated child plans, dependencies, and the critical path on a Gantt chart.
translation: 在甘特图上查看带日期的子计划、依赖关系和关键路径。

english: Capture ideas, vote on proposals, and compare what-if portfolios.
translation: 收集想法，对提案投票，并比较假设情景下的组合。

english: Align plans to OKRs and see per-person load, with over-allocation flagged.
translation: 将计划与 OKR 对齐，查看每个人的负载，并标出超额分配。

english: You need an account to work with real data. Signing in takes under a minute and needs no password.
translation: 处理真实数据需要账号。登录不到一分钟，也不需要密码。

english: Choose Sign in at the top right and enter your email address.
translation: 点击右上角的“登录”，输入你的邮箱地址。

english: Open the magic link we email you. It works once and expires quickly.
translation: 打开我们发到邮箱的魔法链接。它只能使用一次，且很快过期。

english: You return to the app signed in, with nothing to remember or reset.
translation: 你会以已登录状态回到应用，无需记忆或重置任何内容。

english: Use the buttons beside Sign in to change the theme, language and text size, or to share the page.
translation: 使用“登录”旁边的按钮切换主题、语言和文字大小，或分享此页面。

english: A guided walkthrough of the plan registry: how to create a plan, run its delivery board, read its flow, take an idea all the way to a plan, and steer it through governance.
translation: 计划登记库的图文导览：如何创建计划、运行交付看板、读懂流程数据、把想法变成计划，并通过治理来推进。

english: Register a plan with a name, an optional kind label and a parent, so it sits in the one plan tree.
translation: 用名称、可选的类型标签和上级来登记计划，使其位于同一棵计划树中。

english: Open Plans and choose New (or go straight to the new-plan form).
translation: 打开“计划”并选择“新建”（或直接进入新建计划表单）。

english: Fill in Name, which is required, then pick an optional Kind, Status and Priority, and add a Code, Owner org, tags and keywords.
translation: 填写必填的“名称”，再按需选择“类型”“状态”和“优先级”，并添加“代码”、所属组织、标签和关键词。

english: Set Parent portfolio (pid) to place the plan inside another plan, and add any identifiers you already hold.
translation: 设置“上级组合 (pid)”把计划放到另一个计划之内，并添加你已有的标识符。

english: Choose Create. The plan is saved and you land on its detail page.
translation: 选择“创建”。计划随即保存，并跳转到它的详情页。

english: Find a plan and deal with duplicates
Filter the plan list, open a record, and check whether it repeats another plan before you merge it.
translation: 筛选计划列表，打开记录，并在合并前检查它是否与其他计划重复。

english: On Plans, use the grid filter to narrow the list by Name, then open a plan to see its Kind, Status, Code, Owner org, tags and identifiers.
translation: 在“计划”中用表格筛选按名称缩小范围，再打开计划查看其类型、状态、代码、所属组织、标签和标识符。

english: On the detail page choose Check duplicates. Likely matches appear under Potential duplicates with their scores.
translation: 在详情页选择“检查重复”。可能的匹配项会连同分数显示在“潜在重复”下。

english: Open the matching plan to compare the two, then use Edit to correct either record.
translation: 打开匹配的计划进行对比，然后用“编辑”修正其中任一条记录。

english: On Merge, enter the Surviving plan id and Duplicate plan id, choose Load preview, then Merge. The duplicate is soft-deleted and listed under Recent merges.
translation: 在“合并”中输入保留计划的 id 和重复计划的 id，选择“加载预览”，再点“合并”。重复项被软删除，并列在“最近合并”中。

english: Each plan has a Kanban board, with sprints and a burndown, to track its tasks.
translation: 每个计划都有带冲刺和燃尽图的看板，用来跟踪任务。

english: Open a plan and choose Board.
Enter a New task title, optional story points and a sprint, then choose Add task.
translation: 输入新任务标题、可选的故事点和冲刺，然后选择 Add task。

english: Drag a card between Todo, In progress, In review, Done and Blocked. Each drag is saved as a status change.
translation: 在 Todo、In progress、In review、Done 和 Blocked 之间拖动卡片。每次拖动都会保存为一次状态变更。

english: Under Sprints, enter a Sprint name with a start and end date and choose Add sprint. Select it to see the burndown, and use the standup, retro notes and velocity sections.
translation: 在 Sprints 下输入冲刺名称及开始、结束日期，选择 Add sprint。选中它即可查看燃尽图，并使用站会、回顾笔记和速率部分。

english: Time-based analysis shows where a plan's calendar time goes, not just how busy people are.
translation: 基于时间的分析显示计划的日历时间花在哪里，而不仅仅是大家有多忙。

english: Open a plan and choose Flow.
Read the headline tiles first: Service level expectation, Flow efficiency, First pass yield and Work in progress.
translation: 先看核心指标：Service level expectation、Flow efficiency、First pass yield 和 Work in progress。

english: Check Aging work in progress for items that have waited longer than expected, then look at Blocked and Rework.
translation: 在 Aging work in progress 中查看等待时间超出预期的事项，再看 Blocked 和 Rework。

english: Use the Cumulative flow window, the Constraints ranking and the Distributions to see what is slowing delivery. Nothing here ranks individual people.
translation: 用 Cumulative flow 时间窗、Constraints 排名和 Distributions 找出拖慢交付的原因。这里不会对任何个人排名。

english: Capture an idea, let people vote, then move it through a proposal into a real plan.
translation: 记录一个想法，让大家投票，再经由提案变成真正的计划。

english: Open Ideas and use Capture with an Idea title and a Pitch. People vote with the up arrow, and the most-voted ideas come first.
translation: 打开“想法”，用“记录”填写想法标题和简介。大家用向上箭头投票，得票最多的想法排在最前。

english: Pick a Convert target and choose To proposal. An idea nobody will act on can be dismissed instead.
translation: 选择转换目标，再点“转为提案”。没人会跟进的想法可以直接驳回。

english: Open Proposals (work intake). A draft is submitted, then reviewed, then approved or rejected. Use duplicates? to check for repeated demand.
translation: 打开“提案”（工作受理）。草稿先提交、再审阅，然后批准或拒绝。用 duplicates? 检查重复需求。

english: Choose promote on an approved proposal. It becomes a plan, and the work item link takes you to it.
translation: 在已批准的提案上选择 promote。它会变成计划，工作项链接会带你过去。

english: One panel holds a plan's gates, risks, budget, benefits, milestones and allocations.
translation: 一个面板汇集计划的关口、风险、预算、收益、里程碑和资源分配。

english: Open a plan and choose Governance.
Under Gate journey, choose a decision (approved, approved with conditions, hold or rejected) and Record decision to move to the next gate.
translation: 在“阶段关口”下选择一个决定（approved、approved_with_conditions、hold 或 rejected），点“记录决定”进入下一关口。

english: Raise a New risk and escalate it if it grows. Add Budget lines with a category and planned amount, and declare Benefits, then realize them as they arrive.
translation: 提出新风险，风险扩大时上报。添加带类别和计划金额的预算行，声明收益，并在收益到位时标记实现。

english: Add Milestones, mark them complete, and use Allocate to give people capacity. The Schedule link draws the dates and dependencies.
translation: 添加里程碑并标记完成，用 Allocate 给人员分配容量。“进度表”链接会画出日期和依赖关系。

english: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
Sign-in was cancelled or is not permitted by your organization.
translation: 登录已取消，或您的组织不允许登录。

english: The sign-in service cannot be reached. Please try again later.
translation: 无法访问登录服务，请稍后再试。

english: Could not move {title} to {column}; it is back where it was.
translation: 无法将 {title} 移至 {column}，已恢复到原位置。

english: Shaded columns are days off: weekends and holidays in this plan's working calendar.
translation: 阴影列为休息日：本计划工作日历中的周末和假日。
已将 {n} 个任务导出到 {file}

english: Each bar is a cost range; taller means more simulations ended there. Solid lines are P50, P80 and P90 (labelled); the dashed line is the budget.
translation: 每根柱代表一个成本区间，越高表示落在该区间的模拟次数越多。实线为 P50、P80 和 P90（已标注），虚线为预算。

english: Each plan's budget and mean simulated cost in {currency}
translation: 各计划的预算和平均模拟成本（{currency}）

english: No register risk was used as a cost event.
translation: 未将任何登记风险用作成本事件。
各条目的估算和敏感度（{currency}）

english: Seed {seed}: the same seed gives the same result. Up to {max_iterations} iterations.
translation: 种子 {seed}：相同的种子给出相同的结果。最多 {max_iterations} 次迭代。

english: The same figures as a table
cannot meet a constraint or deadline (the line marks the limit)
translation: 无法满足约束或截止日期（线条标示限制）

english: critical: any slip moves the finish
translation: 关键：任何延误都会推迟完成日期

english: No scheduled tasks to draw yet. Give a task a duration (and a start date or a predecessor).
translation: 暂无可绘制的已排期任务。请为任务设置工期（以及开始日期或前置任务）。

english: the outline under a bar is where it was baselined
translation: 条形下方的轮廓表示其基线位置

english: {from} to {to}. Float is counted in the plan's business days; bars are drawn in calendar days.
translation: {from} 至 {to}。浮动时间按本计划的工作日计算；条形按日历日绘制。

english: Task schedule with float, in the plan's business days
translation: 任务进度及浮动时间（按本计划的工作日）

english: the vertical gap above “Done” is work in progress; the horizontal gap to it is roughly the cycle time
translation: “已完成”上方的垂直间距为在制品；到它的水平间距约为周期时间
共 {total} · 进行中 {work_in_progress} · 已完成 {done}

english: The double line is the budget at completion: {money}.
Which way is good ({v}) cannot be changed: it would re-colour every past reading.
translation: “哪个方向为好”（{v}）不可更改：否则会改变所有历史读数的颜色。
没有带日期的任务可显示。

english: That range is too long for one column per {unit}; showing one per {unit2}.
translation: 该范围过长，无法每{unit}一列；改为每{unit2}一列。

english: Planned is {money}, the likely cost. Leave a field empty to clear it.
translation: 计划值为 {money}，即可能成本。留空某字段即可清除。

english: Every move is kept in the history: the old date, the new one, why, and who.
translation: 每次调整都会记入历史：原日期、新日期、原因及操作者。

english: Pick the tasks that must be done
This plan has no tasks yet.
When all those tasks are done
translation: 当这些任务全部完成时

english: No scheduled tasks to draw yet.
translation: 暂无可绘制的已排期任务。

english: Task network: boxes are tasks, arrows are dependencies
translation: 任务网络：方框为任务，箭头为依赖关系

english: The same network as a list
Currency (for example EUR, JPY or GBP)
translation: 货币（例如 EUR、JPY 或 GBP）

english: Plan search is not available right now. Commands still work.
translation: 计划搜索暂不可用，命令仍可使用。

english: Type a plan name or a command

Copy cells from a spreadsheet and paste them here: one task per line, with the columns Title, Deadline (yyyy-mm-dd) and Notes, in that order. The date becomes the task's deadline. A first line that names the columns is skipped. A row with a problem is shown with the reason and is left out.
translation: 从电子表格复制单元格并粘贴到此处：每行一个任务，列依次为标题、截止日期（yyyy-mm-dd）和备注。日期将成为任务的截止日期。若首行为列名则会跳过。有问题的行会显示原因并被排除。

english: “{value}” is not a date; write it as yyyy-mm-dd
the notes are longer than {max} characters
the title is longer than {max} characters
— it has no measurable key result yet, so it has no score (not zero).
translation: — 尚无可衡量的关键结果，因此没有得分（不是零分）。

english: Key results in more than one currency are scored separately; currencies are never converted.
translation: 以多种货币计量的关键结果分别计分；货币从不换算。

english: The baseline, metric and direction cannot be changed: progress from a moving baseline is not progress.
translation: 基线、指标和方向不可更改：基线变动下的进展不算真正的进展。

english: Who does what (RACI matrix): who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed on each task
translation: 职责分工（RACI 矩阵）：每项任务的负责人、批准人、咨询人和知会人

english: One probability covers both effects: a risk that delays a task and adds cost strikes once and does both. Leave a part empty to leave it out.
translation: 一个概率同时适用于两种影响：既延迟任务又增加成本的风险只发生一次，且两者同时发生。留空某部分即不计入。

english: Line: planned value ({from} to {to}). ● earned value and ■ actual cost, only on days recorded ({snapshots} so far). Dashed: budget at completion, {money}.
translation: 线条：计划值（{from} 至 {to}）。● 挣值和 ■ 实际成本，仅显示已记录的日期（目前 {snapshots} 次）。虚线：完工预算，{money}。

english: S-curve: planned value over time, with recorded earned value and actual cost
translation: S 曲线：计划值随时间的变化，以及已记录的挣值和实际成本

english: The same figures as a table
Schedule variance against the baseline, in business days
translation: 相对基线的进度偏差（工作日）

english: The plan's own finish cannot be compared.
translation: 无法比较计划本身的完成日期。
无操作者的已记录操作：
{returned} 行 · {distinct_actors} 位不同操作者 · {actorless} 条无操作者

english: Claim-based, so a deadline fires exactly once even if the ticker and a manual sweep race.
translation: 基于认领机制，即使定时器与手动扫描同时运行，截止事件也只触发一次。

english: Configure a rule once; as items move across the board the platform applies it. Rules never block the move that triggered them — a failure is recorded as a failed run, not an undo.
translation: 规则只需配置一次；事项在看板上移动时，平台会自动应用。规则从不阻止触发它的移动 — 失败会记录为一次失败运行，而不会撤销操作。
斜线延伸部分：提议中，不计入

english: over capacity (solid bar: firm bookings; line: capacity in force)
translation: 超出产能（实心条：已确认预订；线条：有效产能）

english: within capacity, but committing the proposed bookings would exceed it
translation: 在产能范围内，但确认提议的预订将会超出
关口评审时效阈值：{review_days} 个日历日

english: Cost rates are finance data. You do not have access to them.
translation: 成本费率属于财务数据，你无权访问。

english: No rate yet: work by this {v} is not costed.
translation: 尚无费率：此{v}的工作不计成本。

english: Band for lines with no estimate (± %)
What all your plans together could cost, given each budget line's range and the risks that add cost. Each currency is on its own; they are never added.
translation: 根据每个预算条目的区间和会增加成本的风险，估算所有计划合计可能的成本。各货币分别计算，从不相加。

english: Go back to the default for my role
translation: 恢复为我角色的默认设置

english: How the app looks and reads. These never change what you can do.
translation: 应用的外观和阅读方式。这些设置不会改变你的操作权限。

english: Keeps the everyday pages in front (My work, Plans, Board, Calendar, Tour) and puts the rest behind a “More” link. Every page is still there and still works.
translation: 将常用页面（我的工作、计划、看板、日历、导览）放在前面，其余页面收进“更多”链接。所有页面依然存在且正常可用。

english: Sign in to keep these on your account as well as on this device.
translation: 登录后，这些设置将同时保存在你的账号和此设备上。

english: This is the default for your role: {v}.
translation: 这是你角色的默认设置：{v}。

english: Untick a section to hide it from the top bar. It stays one step away at its address, and you can show it again here. Nothing is saved until you hide one, so sections added later reach you.
translation: 取消勾选某栏目即可在顶栏中隐藏它。它仍可通过其地址访问，你也可以在此重新显示。在你隐藏栏目之前不会保存任何设置，因此日后新增的栏目会自动显示。

english: Where calendars start each week. By default it follows the language you chose; week numbers stay ISO weeks, which start on Monday.
translation: 日历中每周从哪一天开始。默认跟随您选择的语言；周数仍为 ISO 周，从星期一开始。
使用阅读障碍友好字体

english: Uses the OpenDyslexic typeface, with wider spacing between letters, words and lines.
translation: 使用 OpenDyslexic 字体，并加大字母、单词和行之间的间距。

english: This version's text is final. A change goes in the next draft.
translation: 此版本的正文已定稿。如需修改，请在下一版草稿中进行。
版本 {version} 于 {on} 时现行有效。

english: What was in force on a date
Policies and procedures. A new version is reviewed and approved before it comes into force, and a version in force never changes.
translation: 政策与程序。新版本须经审阅和批准后方可生效，且现行版本永不更改。
{unresolved_incidents} 个事件未解决（计入数量，不计时）。
{untagged} 个事项没有 MoSCoW 标签。
尚未接收任何部署事件。

english: Something you track over time against a target, so you can see early whether you are on course.
translation: 随时间对照目标跟踪的指标，便于及早发现是否偏离方向。

english: Standing measures. Green is at or better than the target; red is at or worse than the red line; amber is between. A KPI nobody has read yet shows “No data yet”.

translation: 将 {name} 关联到劳动力服务
劳动力服务技能池 ID

english: Copy it from the pool in the workforce service: 36 characters, lower case, with hyphens, like 3f2a8c1e-0b4d-4e6f-9a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b.
translation: 从劳动力服务中的技能池复制：36 个字符，小写，带连字符，例如 3f2a8c1e-0b4d-4e6f-9a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b。

english: That is not a workforce service pool id: it must be 36 characters, lower case, with hyphens.
translation: 这不是劳动力服务技能池 ID：必须为 36 个字符，小写，带连字符。

english: Remove the link between {name} and the workforce service? Its supply on the heatmap will again be what was entered here. Every demand figure already sent to the workforce service for this pool will be withdrawn there (sent as zero).
translation: 确定移除 {name} 与劳动力服务之间的关联吗？其在热力图上的供给将恢复为在此录入的数据。已为此技能池发送到劳动力服务的所有需求数据都将在那边撤回（以零发送）。

english: {name} is now linked to the workforce service pool {ref}.
translation: {name} 现已关联到劳动力服务技能池 {ref}。

english: {name} is no longer linked to the workforce service.
translation: {name} 已不再关联到劳动力服务。

english: Another pool here is already linked to that workforce service pool. Remove that link first: one pool here per pool there.
translation: 此处已有另一个技能池关联到该劳动力服务技能池。请先移除那个关联：两边的技能池须一一对应。

english: The service did not accept that id. It must be the workforce service's pool id: 36 characters, lower case, with hyphens.
translation: 服务不接受该 ID。它必须是劳动力服务的技能池 ID：36 个字符，小写，带连字符。

english: That pool no longer exists. The list has been loaded again.
translation: 该技能池已不存在。列表已重新加载。

english: The link could not be changed.
Demand figures being withdrawn from the workforce service pool it was linked to: {n}.
translation: 正在从先前关联的劳动力服务技能池撤回的需求数据：{n}。

english: Record capacity promised to a programme (supply) or work a programme needs from a skill pool (demand), for one month, in full-time equivalents.
translation: 以全职当量记录某一个月向项目群承诺的产能（供给），或项目群需要从技能池获得的工作量（需求）。

english: For a pool linked to the workforce service, a demand commitment also sends the programme's total demand for that pool and month there. A total of zero withdraws the figure there. Nothing is retried: save again to send again.
translation: 对于关联到劳动力服务的技能池，需求承诺还会将该项目群在此技能池和月份的总需求发送到该服务。总数为零会在那边撤回该数据。不会自动重试：再次保存即可再次发送。

english: The plan must be a programme (a plan of kind Program).
translation: 该计划必须是项目群（类型为 Program 的计划）。

english: Demand: work the programme needs from the pool
translation: 需求：项目群需要从技能池获得的工作量

english: Supply: capacity promised to the programme
translation: 供给：向项目群承诺的产能

english: Leave it empty for your own organization.
Give a month as year and month.
translation: 请以年份和月份填写月份。

english: A number from 0 to 1000, written as you write numbers. Zero withdraws a demand figure sent to the workforce service.
translation: 0 到 1000 之间的数字，按你平时的数字写法填写。零会撤回已发送到劳动力服务的需求数据。

english: What was actually delivered, if known.
translation: 实际交付的数量（如已知）。

english: A number from 0 to 1000, written as you write numbers.
translation: 0 到 1000 之间的数字，按你平时的数字写法填写。

english: That programme was not found, or you cannot read it.
translation: 未找到该项目群，或你无权读取。

english: The service did not accept it. The plan must be a programme, the pool an active one, and each figure from 0 to 1000.
translation: 服务未接受。计划必须是项目群，技能池必须是启用状态，且每个数值须在 0 到 1000 之间。

english: The commitment could not be saved.
The capacity commitments could not be loaded.

translation: 正在加载最近的发送记录…

english: Recent sends to the workforce service
translation: 最近发送到劳动力服务的记录

english: The latest send for each programme, pool and month, newest first. A send that was started shows its answer here once it arrives: refresh to see it.
translation: 每个项目群、技能池和月份的最近一次发送，最新的在前。已发起的发送在收到回复后会显示在此处：请刷新查看。

english: Nothing has been sent to the workforce service yet.
translation: 尚未向劳动力服务发送任何内容。

english: This commitment is not sent to the workforce service: only demand on a pool linked to it is.
translation: 此承诺不会发送到劳动力服务：只有关联技能池上的需求才会发送。

english: Nothing has been sent to the workforce service for this programme, pool and month yet.
translation: 尚未就此项目群、技能池和月份向劳动力服务发送任何内容。

english: Sending {fte} full-time equivalent (the programme's total for this pool and month) to the workforce service. Its answer appears under Recent sends.
translation: 正在向劳动力服务发送 {fte} 全职当量（该项目群在此技能池和月份的总数）。回复将显示在“最近发送记录”下。

english: Withdrawing this programme's figure for this pool and month from the workforce service, because the total is now zero. Its answer appears under Recent sends.
translation: 由于总数现为零，正在从劳动力服务撤回该项目群在此技能池和月份的数据。回复将显示在“最近发送记录”下。

english: The workforce service took {fte} full-time equivalent.
translation: 劳动力服务已接收 {fte} 全职当量。

english: The workforce service withdrew its figure for this programme, pool and month.
translation: 劳动力服务已撤回其关于此项目群、技能池和月份的数据。

english: The workforce service already had this figure; nothing changed there.
translation: 劳动力服务已有此数据；那边没有变化。

english: The workforce service refused it. Nothing is retried; save again to send again.
translation: 劳动力服务拒绝了该数据。不会自动重试；再次保存即可再次发送。

english: The workforce service could not be reached, or did not answer in time. Nothing is retried; save again to send again.
translation: 无法连接劳动力服务，或其未及时回复。不会自动重试；再次保存即可再次发送。

english: Not sent: this service is not set up to reach the workforce service.
translation: 未发送：此服务未配置连接劳动力服务。

english: Not sent: there was no sign-in to pass on to the workforce service.
translation: 未发送：没有可传递给劳动力服务的登录凭据。

english: Not sent: the workforce service takes at most 10 000 full-time equivalent.
translation: 未发送：劳动力服务最多接受 10 000 全职当量。

english: Not sent: a zero recorded before zeros were sent, so the workforce service kept its last figure. Save again to withdraw it.
translation: 未发送：该零值是在开始发送零值之前记录的，因此劳动力服务保留了其最后的数据。再次保存即可撤回。
